result.notes: SendGrid (now part of Twilio) has a self-serve signup flow leading to a free trial, then paid plans; docs page emphasizes "free trial—no credit card required" rather than a permanent free tier, so classified as self_serve_trial rather than self_serve_free. API key is generated from account settings (app.sendgrid.com/settings/api_keys) and used as a Bearer token in the Authorization header — no OAuth2 flow is documented for the core v3 API. REST API is large (~334 endpoints per apis.guru spec). No official vendor MCP server found; only community MCP implementations exist in the registry. Unauthenticated probe against api.sendgrid.com/v3/templates confirms API key requirement (401 with generic "authorization required" error, no WWW-Authenticate scheme header).
result.one_liner: SendGrid (Twilio) is a transactional and marketing email platform with a REST API for sending email, managing templates, contacts, and campaigns.
